name: gl1f-crypto
description: GL1F Crypto: no-code machine learning for crypto markets on GenesisL1. Dataset, training, backtest, Model NFT deployment with per-model licenses and publicly burnable protocol fees, and verifiable inference.

scripts.test: npm run test:site && npm run test:backtest && npm run test:numeric && npm run test:engine && npm run test:world && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: python3 scripts/generate_crypto_contracts.py --check && node tests/test_crypto_fee_burn.mjs && node tests/test_crypto_admin_licenses.mjs && node tests/sdk_check.mjs
scripts.test:world: node tests/world_signals_check.mjs && node tests/world_data_fetch_check.mjs && node tests/report_check.mjs && node tests/profile_features_check.mjs && node tests/replay_window_check.mjs
